task.name: pick_cube_drawer_plate
task.description: Use the left arm to pick up the pink cube from the drawer and place it on the plate.

substages.substage: 1. Move the left arm to approach and align with the pink cube in the drawer.
2. Grasp the pink cube with the left arm.
3. Move the left arm to align with the plate.
4. Release the gripper to place the pink cube on the plate.
